project.title: Cloud-Native Platform Hardening and Sustainability Initiative
project.objective: Design and roll out a secure, compliant, and greener cloud-native platform baseline across key services, with clear governance and automation.
deliverables: Cloud security and risk governance framework for production workloads
Hardened cloud-native reference architecture and deployment patterns
Automated CI/CD security and compliance controls with runbooks
Green ICT assessment and optimization plan for cloud workloads
Executive roadmap and KPI dashboard for security and sustainability
Training and onboarding materials for engineering and operations teams
constraints: Initial rollout limited to two major cloud environments and core services
Must comply with internal ICT security policies and relevant legislation
Minimal downtime for existing production workloads during migration
Security controls must be automatable via existing CI/CD tooling
Sustainability improvements must be measurable with agreed metrics

risks.risk: Engineering teams resist adopting new security and sustainability standards.
risks.mitigation: Involve key engineers early, provide clear benefits, phased rollout, and targeted training.

risks.risk: Automated controls introduce deployment friction or pipeline failures.
risks.mitigation: Pilot in non-critical services, add feature flags and rollback paths, monitor and tune thresholds.

risks.risk: Inadequate visibility into current cloud usage and emissions baselines.
risks.mitigation: Integrate cloud cost and usage data, define proxy metrics, and validate with sample workloads.

risks.risk: Regulatory or policy requirements are misinterpreted in technical design.
risks.mitigation: Cybersecurity risk manager reviews all controls, and legal/compliance sign off key decisions.

risks.risk: Timeline slips due to competing priorities for platform and product teams.
risks.mitigation: CIO sponsors project, sets clear milestones, and negotiates capacity with team leads.

themes.why_relevant: Defines minimum controls for all services and guides architecture and automation choices.
Ensures platform changes meet ICT security legislation and internal governance needs.
Security and sustainability controls must be integrated into CI/CD and runtime automation.
Aligns cloud usage with sustainability goals and reduces wasteful resource consumption.
Success depends on teams understanding, accepting, and consistently using the new baseline.

backlog.task: Define cloud security and risk governance framework for production workloads
definition_of_done: Framework document approved by CIO and security stakeholders
Roles, responsibilities, and decision rights clearly defined
Risk assessment and exception handling processes documented
Shared in central repository and communicated to platform teams

backlog.task: Design hardened cloud-native reference architecture for core services
definition_of_done: Architecture diagrams and patterns created for target cloud environments
Security controls mapped to governance framework requirements
Scalability, resilience, and observability patterns documented
Reviewed by cybersecurity risk manager and CIO

backlog.task: Implement CI/CD security gates and compliance checks
definition_of_done: Static and dependency scanning integrated into pipelines
Infrastructure as code validated against security policies
Pipeline templates updated and documented for reuse
Pilot service successfully deployed using new gates

backlog.task: Develop runtime security monitoring and incident runbooks
definition_of_done: Key runtime security alerts defined and configured
Incident triage and escalation runbooks drafted
Runbooks validated in tabletop exercise with platform team
Runbooks stored in central knowledge base

backlog.task: Assess current cloud workloads for energy and resource efficiency
definition_of_done: Baseline report on resource utilization and emissions proxies created
Top inefficient workloads and patterns identified
Findings validated with DevOps and development teams
Prioritized list of optimization opportunities agreed

backlog.task: Define green ICT optimization guidelines for cloud workloads
definition_of_done: Guidelines covering right-sizing, scheduling, and storage created
Alignment with ICT security and compliance requirements checked
Examples tailored for common application patterns included
Guidelines published and shared with engineering teams

backlog.task: Update application code and infrastructure to align with new baseline
definition_of_done: Target pilot service refactored to use reference architecture
Security and green ICT guidelines applied where relevant
All automated tests and security checks passing in CI/CD
Deployment to staging and production completed without major incidents

backlog.task: Define executive roadmap, KPIs, and reporting cadence
definition_of_done: Roadmap with milestones for security and sustainability rollout created
KPIs for risk reduction and efficiency agreed with stakeholders
Reporting format and cadence defined for leadership reviews
Roadmap communicated to impacted teams

backlog.task: Create training materials for engineers on new platform baseline
definition_of_done: Slide deck and short reference guide drafted
Examples include CI/CD changes and coding best practices
Content reviewed by cybersecurity risk manager and green ICT consultant
Training sessions scheduled and announced

backlog.task: Prioritize and approve initial set of services for migration
definition_of_done: Selection criteria for candidate services defined
List of initial services agreed with service owners
Risks and dependencies for each service documented
Migration plan aligned with overall roadmap

backlog.task: Document exception handling and temporary waivers process
definition_of_done: Criteria for exceptions and waivers clearly defined
Approval workflow and time limits documented
Template for exception requests created
Process communicated to engineering and product teams

backlog.task: Set up shared dashboard for security and sustainability KPIs
definition_of_done: Dashboard connected to CI/CD, runtime, and cost data sources
Key metrics for risk posture and efficiency visualized
Access granted to CIO, risk, and engineering leads
Dashboard link added to project documentation

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, success metrics, and initial services for the baseline rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: CIO posts project kickoff summary and asks for feedback on scope and priorities.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm and, if needed, adjust the project scope and success metrics in A7.
Approve the initial list of services for migration as defined in T10.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on the cloud security governance framework and exception process.
threads_plan.trigger: Cybersecurity risk manager shares draft governance framework and asks for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the Cloud Security and Risk Governance Framework in A1.
Finalize the exception and waiver process described in A6 and T11.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in the hardened reference architecture and CI/CD security gates.
threads_plan.trigger: Cloud DevOps engineer posts proposed reference architecture and pipeline changes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the hardened cloud-native reference architecture in A2.
Agree on the mandatory CI/CD security checks listed in A4 and their rollout plan.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prioritize green ICT optimizations and align with development plans.
threads_plan.trigger: Green ICT consultant shares baseline assessment and draft optimization guidelines.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the Green ICT Optimization Guidelines in A3.
Select top optimization opportunities from A5 to include in the first rollout wave.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan training, communication, and adoption support for engineering teams.
threads_plan.trigger: Software developer posts draft training pack and proposes training schedule.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async standup where each role posts progress, blockers, and next steps.
Weekly architecture and risk review thread to discuss design changes and approvals.
Bi-weekly KPI snapshot post linking to dashboards and summarizing key trends.
Post-milestone retrospective thread after each migration wave to capture learnings.
Ad-hoc incident review mini-threads when security or deployment issues occur.
